description.value:
Trigger You die.

Duration permanent

Your Persistent Bloom does not end when you die. It remains centred on the square where you fell, at half its radius, permanently — it has no duration and, like any [TERRAIN] effect, can be cleared only by work. It is no longer yours: it does not answer to you, it gains no benefit from your Cutting or your feats, and it does not move. If you are returned to life, it stays where it is and you may create a new Persistent Bloom as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: `TERRAIN-NULL` for the persistence/radius-halving. Same open question as Persistent Bloom, Unbounded: the base "Persistent Bloom" feature this modifies isn't present in this file set.
